nesnd_crisis.33.d.value: Veterans, local scholars and dispossessed farmers in Shanxi have gathered over the hardship and arrests that followed the land surveys. Republican organisers use village schools and old military connections to circulate petitions, calling on each county to choose delegates and hold officers accountable for the seizure of farmland.\n\nSeveral garrisons refuse to surrender the accused officers and have turned away the governor's investigators. The county delegates demand the removal of the chief commissioner, a fresh review of titles and compensation for the injured farmers. Republican organisers are seeking allies among the troops and preparing to rise if their petitions fail. The Ministry of Justice has referred the case to the court: dismiss the officials and reopen the inquiry, or prosecute the assemblies for defying the law.

flavorCNE.6.d.value: Land commissioners in [SCOPE.sState('cne_land_reform_mess_imprisonment_state').GetName] have arrested villagers who drafted petitions over disputed titles and placed them in military custody for concealing property. Officers widened the arrests to local gentry, teachers and clerks who kept the old deeds.\n\nThe new law empowers officials to settle land ownership, but also permits farmers to defend their property. The prisoners' families have taken their deeds to the provincial capital, and the governor has referred the case to the Ministry of Justice. The commissioners warn of collusion and unrest and ask the Ministry of War to protect the officers involved. Transferring a few officials would allow the affair to pass quietly. A prosecution would make the reform's own agents answer for crimes committed in its name.

flavorCNE.7.d.value: Manufacturers and merchants in [SCOPE.sState('cne_land_reform_industrialists_support_state').GetName] have jointly offered to finance land reform. Workshops are expanding and more carts travel the commercial roads. They want the new law to allow farming families to move freely and bring more workers into the towns.\n\nTheir representatives also seek to submit proposals on land, roads and employment contracts through the Consultative Council. The governor is willing to accept the funding. Officials in the Ministry of Revenue argue that these wealthy men understand industry and could take a greater part in government. The rising manufacturers hope to gain a position in imperial affairs commensurate with their wealth.

flavorCNE.8.d.value: The streets of [SCOPE.sState('cne_land_reform_peasants_in_city_state').GetName] are filling with newcomers from the countryside. Farming families have sold their land and come in search of wages. Employment brokers send them to factories and building sites, deducting recruitment and lodging charges from their pay.\n\nWorkers have accused the brokers of withholding contracts and enforcing old debts. Manufacturers fear that an inquiry will disrupt recruitment, while local gentry defend brokers linked to their own associations. The governor must decide whether to prosecute the organisations that bind workers to them or leave the disputes to ordinary civil proceedings. In these growing towns, the promise that peasants could leave their old estates and freely earn a living faces its first practical tests.

nesnd_south_succession_board_reason.value: Whose realm is Southern Ming: the Zhu emperor’s, or the Zheng family’s creation? Nanjing retains the imperial succession, while the Southern Administration in Hangzhou commands the troops and revenues that sustain reform. The Western provinces and Hangzhou could postpone their dispute over sovereign and minister while resisting the North. With reform reaching deep into provincial life, they can no longer avoid the question of who will govern.\n\nHuguang’s academies and Xiangfan’s troops uphold the Zhu succession, while Sichuan’s republicans continue to debate the Southern Administration’s reforms. Governors in the Southern Seas and lords in Japan weigh the land, money and soldiers a new dynasty might demand. Representatives in the Assembly of Rites, ministers in the cabinet and provincial commanders will eventually have to answer for their choices.

nesnd_protect_chen_button_desc.value: 陈东阳主持的改制触及士族、旧封君与军官的田产和爵位。东关先生本人虽无所畏惧，朝廷却不能轻视这些敌意。安排专任护卫，并决定是否令他暂留官署、清查内应，以保全继续推动新政的力量。\n\n警卫任期#v 六个月#!。未设专卫时，本案死亡、负伤、脱险的概率为#v 40／25／35#!；详细经费与续办办法见警卫议案。

flavorCNE.6.d.value: [SCOPE.sState('cne_land_reform_mess_imprisonment_state').GetName]的清丈官员拘捕了一批代写田契诉状的乡民，将他们以串通隐产的罪名交由驻军看押。军官随即扩大搜捕，地方士绅、乡校教员与整理旧契的书吏都被带入营中。\n\n新法赋予官员清理田产的权力，也准许农户为自己的产业提出申诉。囚犯的家属带着田契到省城求告，省督将案情报请刑部查办。负责清丈的官员却以军民勾连、恐生变乱为由，请兵部保护承办军官。若只把涉事官吏调离，营中的追捕便可轻轻揭过；若要追究，清丈官也须为奉行新法时犯下的罪行负责。
